services.name: summer camp
services.desc: Get outside with PEEC this summer! We offer a variety of day camps and clubs to help kids explore the outdoors, make new friends, and have fun. Find the best camp for your child by age. For all grades, the child must be entering that grade in the Fall of 2026. Ignite your child’s summer with excitement at PEEC! This outdoor adventure camp promises a thrilling connection with nature and the environment. From making new friends to exploring canyons around the Los Alamos Nature Center and Los Conchas trail in the Jemez mountains, your kid will have a blast playing, hiking, and discovering a love for the great outdoors on the vibrant Pajarito Plateau. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We are excited to offer standards-based field trips with PEEC! We offer trips to the Nature Center as well as educator-led experiences at your school. Note that many field trips are seasonal and only offered during certain times of the year. For Los Alamos schools, there is no fee for the field trip. You only need to cover transportation for the Nature Center trips. Some classes have used the Atomic City Transit to travel to the Nature Center. We cannot accommodate groups larger than 60 at the nature center. Please schedule two visits for groups larger than this. Use the button below to submit a request.
